operations.name: transfer
operations.description: Initiate a domain transfer from another registrar. "nameserver_mode" chooses what happens with the nameservers: "platform" (default) points the domain at our nameservers once the transfer completes, "external" keeps the nameservers of the previous provider (no zone is created here; switch later with POST {domain}/nameservers/platform). "dns_import" (only with "platform") takes the current DNS records of the old provider along: "scan" scans them for review, "apply" scans and writes them into our zone automatically. Default is "none".

operations.name: serversComplaintsDelete
operations.description: Deletes a specific complaint from the TeamSpeak server.

operations.name: serversDelete
operations.description: Permanently deletes a TeamSpeak virtual server. Admin-locked servers cannot be deleted.

operations.name: serversSettingsUpdate
operations.description: Updates server properties like name, welcome message, and host banner.

welcome_message.description: Welcome message shown on connect (max 1024 characters)

hostbanner_url.description: URL opened when clicking the host banner

hostbanner_gfx_url.description: URL of the host banner image

operations.description: Starts a stopped TeamSpeak virtual server.

operations.name: serversStats
operations.description: Returns connection statistics and live data for a running server.

operations.name: serversStatsHistory
operations.description: Returns historical server statistics for a given time period.

operations.name: serversStop
operations.description: Stops a running TeamSpeak virtual server.

operations.name: serversTokens
operations.description: Returns a list of all privilege keys (tokens) and server groups.

operations.name: serversTokensCreate
operations.description: Creates a new privilege key (token) for a server or channel group.

group_id.description: Group ID to assign (use token list endpoint to get available groups)

operations.name: serversTokensDelete
operations.description: Deletes a privilege key (token) from the server.

operations.name: serversTsdnsUpdate

operations.name: serversTsdnsRemove
operations.description: Removes the TSDNS hostname from a TeamSpeak server.

operations.name: serversUpgrade
operations.description: Changes the slot count of a running TeamSpeak server.

slots.description: New slot count (must be within price tier range and match step size)

operations.name: accountsIndex
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of all VPN accounts for the authenticated reseller.

operations.name: accountsShow

operations.name: accountsSuspend
operations.description: Suspends a VPN account. All active sessions will be terminated.

operations.name: accountsTerminate
operations.description: Terminates a VPN account. The account will be disabled but kept for billing records.

operations.name: accountsUnsuspend
operations.description: Unsuspends a previously suspended VPN account.

operations.name: dnsOptions
operations.description: Returns available DNS options for VPN accounts.

operations.name: prices
operations.description: Returns VPN pricing and product information.

operations.name: servers
operations.description: Returns all available VPN server locations grouped by country.

operations.name: organisationsIndex
operations.description: Returns all RIPE organisations for the authenticated reseller, including their contacts.

status.description: Filter by status (pending, creating, active, error)

operations.name: organisationsStore
operations.description: Creates a new RIPE organisation. For internal organisations, a RIPE object will be created asynchronously. For external organisations (is_external=true), provide the ripe_org_id — it will be imported with its existing contacts.

is_external.description: Whether this is an existing external RIPE organisation

ripe_org_id.description: RIPE org ID (required when is_external=true, e.g. ORG-AG123-RIPE)

org_name.description: Official organisation name for RIPE (required when is_external=false)

responses.description: Validation error or external org not valid

operations.name: organisationsVerify
operations.description: Validates that an external RIPE organisation exists and has the required maintainer set. Use this before importing an external org.

responses.description: Organisation not found or missing maintainer
responses.germanDescription: Organisation nicht gefunden oder Maintainer fehlt

operations.name: organisationsDestroy
operations.description: Deletes a RIPE organisation and all its contacts. Not possible if active IP assignments exist.

operations.name: organisationsShow
operations.description: Returns detailed information about a specific RIPE organisation including all contacts.

operations.name: contactsStore
operations.description: Creates a new RIPE contact (person or abuse role) for an organisation. The contact will be created in RIPE asynchronously. Not possible for external organisations.

name.description: NIC handle name (used in RIPE object)

operations.name: contactsDestroy
operations.description: Deletes a RIPE contact from the local database.

operations.name: contactsRetry
operations.description: Retries RIPE object creation for a contact that failed. Only works for contacts with status=error.

operations.name: organisationsRefresh
operations.description: Re-syncs contacts and ASNs from RIPE for an external organisation. Only works for external organisations.

operations.name: organisationsRetry
operations.description: Retries the RIPE object creation for an organisation that failed. Only works for organisations with status=error.

responses.description: Organisation is not in error state

operations.name: list

operations.name: delete
operations.description: Soft-deletes a sub-reseller.

operations.name: get
operations.description: Returns detailed information about a specific sub-reseller.

operations.name: update
operations.description: Updates an existing sub-reseller.

operations.name: pricingShow
operations.description: Returns all configured pricing for a sub-reseller, including product prices, domain TLD prices, and rootserver cluster prices.

operations.name: pricingUpdate
operations.description: Updates pricing for a sub-reseller. Supports product prices, domain prices, and rootserver prices. Each section is optional — only provided sections are updated.

rootserver_prices.description: Array of {cluster_price_id, sell_per_core, sell_per_ram_gb, sell_per_disk_gb, sell_per_ipv4, sell_per_ipv6, sell_setup}
